description: This Scala source file defines implicit conversions and encoders for Spark SQL, including conversions from Scala objects to Dataset, and encoders for primitive and complex types, as well as utility classes for SQL implicits.

classes.name: SQLImplicits
classes.description: Abstract class providing implicit conversions for creating Columns and Datasets from Scala objects.

classes.name: EncoderImplicits
classes.description: Trait providing implicit encoders for various Scala and Java types to be used in Spark SQL.

classes.name: LowPrioritySQLImplicits
classes.description: Trait with lower priority implicit encoders to resolve conflicts, mainly for Product types.
